html:
This afternoon evening tour is perfect for travelers who want to combine nature, culture, and fun in one go: explore the sacred Marble Mountains, enjoy a basket-boat experience in the Coconut Forest, and fall in love with the lantern lit beauty of Hoi An Ancient Town by night.

ITINERARY

14:00 – Pick-up from your hotel

Driver and English-speaking guide pick you up at your hotel in Da Nang and depart for Marble Mountain.

Marble Mountain (Ngu Hanh Son)

  • Visit the famous cluster of five limestone mountains representing the five elements:

    • Kim (Metal), Mộc (Wood), Thủy (Water), Hỏa (Fire), Thổ (Earth)

  • Explore mysterious caves with a sacred Buddhist atmosphere.

  • Visit Tam Thai Pagoda and Linh Ung Pagoda on the mountain.

  • Stop at Non Nuoc Stone Carving Village at the foot of the mountain to admire exquisite stone sculptures crafted by local artisans.

16:00 – Coconut Forest (Bay Mau Coconut Forest)

Head to the famous Coconut Forest and explore the waterways on a traditional basket boat.

You will:

  • Take a basket-boat ride through the peaceful coconut forest.

  • Learn how to cast a fishing net, catch crabs, and join fun basket-boat races.

  • Watch locals perform impressive basket-boat skills and enjoy a mini show of Quang folk melodies.

  • Try making small accessories from coconut leaves with local guidance.

17:30 – Depart to Hoi An Ancient Town

18:00 – Dinner & Hoi An Night Stroll

  • Enjoy a special dinner with local Hoi An dishes such as:

    • Cao Lau, Hoanh Thanh, Banh Bao, Banh Vac and more.

  • Visit Hoi An Ancient Town, a charming UNESCO World Heritage site.

  • Stop at the iconic Japanese Covered Bridge – the most famous symbol of Hoi An.

  • Take a leisurely walk along the Hoai River, enjoy the romantic atmosphere of the old town at night.

  • Admire colorful lanterns hanging along streets, alleys, and houses – a magical and peaceful scene you’ll never forget.

21:00–21:30 – Drop-off at your hotel

End of services. Goodbye and see you again!

TOUR PRICE

30 USD / pax

INCLUDED

  • Transfer by air-conditioned coach in good condition.

  • Dinner with special local dishes in Hoi An.

  • English-speaking guide.

  • Entrance fees for all sightseeing as per itinerary.

  • Mineral water on the coach.

NOTES AND CHILDREN POLICY

Notes:

Please provide personal information when booking:

  • Full name
  • Year of birth
  • Gender
  • Nationality
  • Contact details

Children Policy:

  • 1–4 years old: Free of charge (share dinner with parents).

  • 5–9 years old: 50% of adult price (half portion dinner).

  • From 10 years old and above: Charged as an adult.
